content.title: Rory McIlroy’s Wife Addresses Divorce Rumors Through Her Fashion at Masters Tournament
content.text: DUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - NOVEMBER 16: Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland poses with his Daughter, Poppy and Wife, Erica, holding 7 fingers to the camera, alongside the Race to Dubai trophy on the 18th green on day four of the DP World Tour Championship 2025 at Jumeirah Golf Estates on November 16, 2025 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. (Photo by Luke Walker/Getty Images) As the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National unfolded, defending Masters Champion Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland had to contend not only with competitors who have tightened the margins for the lead, but also with divorce rumors running rampant across the green.McIlroy has been married to his wife, Erica Stoll, for several years, and though there may be rumors of a marital separation now, they’ve been quickly shut down by the pro golfer. Now his wife his chiming in, though she hasn’t had to speak a single word to get her statement across. Instead, she’s communicated through her fashion choices at the Masters Tournament this week.Erica Stoll, Rory McIlroy’s Wife, Has Worn Her Stunning Engagement Ring at the 2026 Masters TournamentGettyAUGUSTA, GEORGIA – APRIL 08: Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland, wife Erica Stoll and daughter Poppy pose for a photo during the Par Three Contest prior to the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 08, 2026 in Augusta, Georgia. (Photo by Andrew Redington/Getty Images) Erica Stoll, who is married to Masters Champion Rory McIlroy and with whom she shares one daughter, has been seen at the 2026 Masters Tournament wearing her iconic 5-carat diamond engagement ring. The choice to wear the ring so prominently is a clear message that puts divorce rumors to rest, especially since her ring is well known to be one of the most famous in the global golf community, according to Sports Illustrated.Of the many professional golf wives and girlfriends, aka WAGs, Stoll’s ring is a fan favorite amid a collection of sparkling and dazzling jewels.The Divorce Rumors Aren’t UnfoundedGettyDUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES – NOVEMBER 16: Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland inspects the Race to Dubai trophy on the 18th green with his Daughter, Poppy as his Wife, Erica, looks on on day four of the DP World Tour Championship 2025 at Jumeirah Golf Estates on November 16, 2025 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. (Photo by Richard Heathcote/Getty Images) Despite Rory McIlroy issuing a statement to put the divorce rumors to rest and Erica Stoll donning her dazzling diamond this weekend, the separation speculation between the pair isn’t far-fetched. In 2024, the golfer actually filed for divorce at a time when he cited irreconcilable divorces – However, the couple made up and found their way back to each other.Whether it’s just for the cameras or in a more profound effort to be joyously present for their young daughter, Poppy, the family of three has been snapped both on and off of the course this weekend at the Masters Tournament held at the Augusta National Golf Club. It’s common knowledge that the couple has tried to move forward with their public image as a couple in a way that portrays a happy family, yet that hasn’t stopped fans, analysts, and observers from speculating on the strength of their marriage. At the same time, the images of the family together have served asa. quiet but powerful response to lingering speculation. And if images of smiles and collective support aren’t enough, all one has to do is look at the rare gem on Stoll’s left hand to know that 2026 divorce rumors have no place at the Masters.
